chunks: Or do they say he has fabricated it? In fact, it is the truth from your Lord so that you may warn the people to whom no admonisher was sent before you. They may haply come to guidance.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Or do they say he has fabricated it?' in Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the authenticity of the Prophet's message against the Quraysh's accusation of fabrication, affirming the Quran as divine truth sent to a people previously devoid of a warner. It highlights the unique prophetic mission to guide those who had not received prior warning, emphasizing the necessity of divine guidance for salvation.
